objective: Frozen computation: the triangle inequality on every parity base to seven distinctions and four knots and random larger ones; the smallest failing base for each non-parity class of three-place laws; not-all-equal bases whose knots meet at most once on seven and eight distinctions; correlation of failing pairs; small not-all-equal weaves on tori.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 5 of 7 predictions held, P3b and P6 failed): no failure of b or b - 1 on 439,652 parity bases; six languages fail on two knots on four distinctions; R5 never fails to seven distinctions and four knots but its twist fails on four with three (P3b failed); not-all-equal meeting once passes on seven distinctions and first fails on eight with five knots; the tori 3x3 to 4x5 pass; a failing pair can be independent (P6 failed).
title: Triangle census
